worked_solution:
The formula for ${}_{n}{P}_{r}$ is given by

$$
{}_{n}{P}_{r}=\frac{n!}{(n-r)!}\,.
$$

Substituting $n=6$ and $r=1$ into the above, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{}_{6}{P}_{1} & =\frac{6!}{(6-1)!} \\  & =\frac{6!}{5!} \\  & =\frac{6\cdot \cancel{5!}}{\cancel{5!}} \\  & =6.\end{aligned}
$$
